features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.description: At 2nd level, you learn the message cantrip.

features.name: Feathered Form
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, when you use Wild Shape to assume a beast form, it can have a flying speed (you ignore the 'no flying speed' limitation).

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: Circle spells: blur/gust of wind (L3), fly/lightning bolt (L5), conjure minor elementals/freedom of movement (L7), cloudkill/conjure elemental (air only) (L9). Always prepared.

features.name: Comforting Breezes
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, action to summon a breeze in a 30-ft cone. Choose WIS mod targets: end one disease or the blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned condition on each. 1/long rest.

features.name: Updraft
features.description: Also at 6th level, expend one Wild Shape as bonus action to summon wind. You and chosen creatures within 10 ft end grappled/restrained. Fly up to 30 ft (no OA). Affected creatures can use reaction to fly 30 ft (no OA).

features.name: Vizier of the Winds
features.description: Starting at 10th level, cast commune without preparing or expending a slot. 1/long rest.

features.name: Hunger of Storm's Fury
features.description: Beginning at 14th level, when you succeed on a save against lightning damage, take no damage and instead regain HP equal to the lightning damage dealt. 1/long rest.
